accessibility: Measured with the compiler's WCAG ratios on the declared pairs: text on ground 16.74:1; text on panel 15.11:1; muted on panel 6.71:1; muted on ground 7.44:1; gold on ground 8.93:1; control ink on gold 8.93:1. Emerald on ground measures 4.79:1 — above the text floor, recorded as a UI pair because the site uses it for labels and signals. Terracotta (4.04:1) and copper (3.37:1) clear only the 3:1 UI floor: they are never body text. These are declared token pairs from the reversed theme, not a full application audit.
antiPatterns: Do not re-skin the site from another package's candidates: on nougenai.com these tokens are canon, and other packages' values (including nougenai-brand's pin green #73fd7c and gold #d4af37) do not apply here. No light theme exists on the site and none is to be invented in its name. Gold stays an accent — pills, rules, keylines, focus — never a field. No decorative gradients, no glass beyond the established carbon/40 blur cards, no accent sprawl: the site's restraint is part of the record.
brandVoice: The site's voice is the newsroom's: plain, confident, receipts-first. Labels are short uppercase with wide tracking ('Updated Regularly', 'Stories & Insights for Everyone'). Nou's Desk speaks as Nou: 'Reports by Nou', 'Listen — Nou reads this edition'.

componentMutations.change: Nou's Desk card on /news: carbon panel at 40% over obsidian with backdrop blur, 1px border in gold at 25%, a 4px gold top rule at 70%, radius 1.5rem; pinned above the live wire; renders nothing until the first edition is published.
The edition's audio sits under the deck as a native player, labelled 'Listen — Nou reads this edition' in gold at 60%, uppercase, wide tracking.
Viewer-local weather chip in the Desk header: the viewer's geolocation drives the site's /api/weather route; the West Palm Beach fallback is labelled '(desk location)'; coordinates are never stored.
Earlier editions list as quiet rows: emerald edition label, ivory title turning gold on hover, stone time at the right.
Gold outline, 2px with 2px offset — the site's own base rule in globals.css.

dataViz: Market and chart accents use gold first, emerald for live series, terracotta for negative movement, copper as the warm secondary. Colour is always paired with a label or a figure; missing data is unavailable, not zero.
density: The news page breathes at an 87.5rem measure (max-w-[1400px] at 2xl) inside a 95% frame, widening on the ultra-wide breakpoints. Cards sit in 2rem grid gaps. One lead per zone; the Desk takes exactly one card above the wire.
description: The canon design tokens of nougenai.com, reversed from the live site's own theme: obsidian ground, carbon panels, ivory text, gold accent, emerald signal, Inter + Syne. Nou's Desk on /news is its first recorded surface.

evidence.note: Every colour, font and breakpoint token in this package was extracted verbatim from the site's own theme: obsidian #111111, carbon #1C1C1C, gold #CFAF5A, copper #8B5E34, emerald #2F8F79, terracotta #C44E3A, ivory #F4F1EA, stone #A6A29C; Inter as --font-sans, Syne as --font-display; ultra-wide breakpoints 120/160/240/480rem; body ground obsidian, text ivory, line-height 1.6; focus outline gold 2px at 2px offset; selection gold on obsidian.
evidence.source: Who-Visions/nougenai-next, src/app/globals.css @theme and @layer base, main at ea8229ee (2026-11-26)

evidence.note: The component idiom these tokens serve: carbon/40 blurred cards with white/5 borders, gold/10 pills with gold/20 borders, uppercase wide-tracked labels, Syne display type, marquee tickers (30s horizontal, 60s vertical), hero slide-progress 6s.

'Reverse the site's design tokens into Nougendesign so that it's canon.' This package is the canon record of nougenai.com's look and governs the site. The nougenai-brand package remains the candidate brand system for future surfaces (dav1d.nougenai.com named first) and does not override this canon on the site.
Nou's Desk — the first surface built and recorded against this canon: edition card, audio player, viewer-local weather chip and archive rows on /news, styled entirely from these tokens.

Site token names were mapped onto nougendesigns/v0 dialect slots (--color-obsidian to --bg, --color-carbon to --panel, --color-ivory to --text, --color-stone to --muted, --color-gold to --accent, --color-copper to --accent-2, --color-emerald to --brand, --color-terracotta to --danger). Values are unchanged; only slot names moved. Translucent tokens (--panel-2, --line, --line-strong, --panel-hover) record the site's alpha idioms (bg-carbon/40, border-white/5 and /10, bg-white/5) in rgba form rather than as invented solids.

iconography: Monochrome line icons (lucide) paired with labels; the gold NEWS in the NOUGENNEWS wordmark is type, not an image. The glowing N pin belongs to the brand package and the channel; the site's own mark is its wordmark.
informationHierarchy: Gold marks the brand and the primary emphasis; emerald marks live/status and edition identity; ivory is the reading layer; stone is metadata and time. Each zone has one lead: the Desk's latest edition above the wire, then the hero carousel, then the stream.
interactionPhysics: Cards are links and read as links: borders warm to gold at 30% on hover, titles turn gold. Focus is a 2px gold outline at 2px offset, everywhere, from the base layer. Asynchronous regions (weather, tickers) degrade to a labelled fallback rather than blocking the page.
materiality: Obsidian #111111 is the ground; carbon #1C1C1C at 40% with backdrop blur is the card material, edged in white at 5%. Ivory #F4F1EA is the reading text; stone #A6A29C is metadata. Gold #CFAF5A reads as metal: rules, ticks, numerals, pills. Emerald #2F8F79 is the live signal — dots, labels, the Desk's edition tags. Copper #8B5E34 and terracotta #C44E3A appear only as warm data accents.
motionGrammar: Tickers move: horizontal marquee 30s linear infinite, vertical marquee 60s, slide-progress 6s for the hero carousel. Content itself does not animate beyond short hover transitions. Reduced motion is honoured by the compiled sheet's policy block.
name: nougenai-site
provenance: Reversed 2026-11-26 from the live site's own code at Dave's ruling ('reverse the site's design tokens into Nougendesign so that it's canon'). Every value is observed from Who-Visions/nougenai-next (globals.css @theme at ea8229ee; the news components) except the dialect slot mapping, recorded as inferred in the evidence. Nothing in this package is invented; where the site has no value (a light theme, a mono font), the package records the absence instead of filling it.
referenceWorld: The live nougenai.com: a dark newsroom surface — obsidian ground, carbon panels, ivory text, one gold accent, a muted emerald for live and status signals, copper and terracotta as warm data accents. Inter carries text; Syne carries display. This package governs nougenai.com and its surfaces, including Nou's Desk on /news. It is the reversed record of a look that already ships, not a proposal.
responsiveBehavior: Stack at narrow widths; the frame is 95% to 2xl, then fixed measures widen through the ultra-wide breakpoints (3xl 120rem, 4xl 160rem, 5xl 240rem, 8k 480rem). The Desk card collapses to one column, image below text. Type and spacing stay rem-based.
stateGrammar: Live regions mark themselves: the emerald dot pulses on 'Updated Regularly'; a stale wire is labelled, never hidden. The Desk states its empty state by absence — no card until the first edition publishes. Weather shows its fallback's name ('desk location') when it is not the viewer's own.
